scripts.package:win: npm run bundle && npx pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-win-x64 --output bin/cardap-print-agent.exe
scripts.package:mac: npm run bundle && npx pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-macos-arm64 --output bin/cardap-print-agent-mac-arm64
